*.version: The program's version as it reports it — the string is the whole content.
*.downloadSpeed: A speed in MB/s whose name and unit say everything; null means the program did not report it.
*.uploadSpeed: A speed in MB/s whose name and unit say everything; null means the program did not report it.
*.active: A plain count of the downloads the program is working on right now.
*.queued: A plain count of the downloads waiting in the program's queue.
*.total: A plain count of every download the program lists.
*.last.finishedTime: The time stamp that belongs to the last finished download next to it.
*.last.failedTime: The time stamp that belongs to the last failed download next to it.
*.downloads.*.status: One word from the fixed status list; the value labels spell it out in the system language.
*.downloads.*.progress: Percent done — the name and the unit % say everything.
*.downloads.*.size: The download's size in GB — the name and the unit say everything.
*.downloads.*.downloaded: The part already loaded, in GB — the name and the unit say everything.
*.downloads.*.speed: The download's current speed in MB/s — the name and the unit say everything.
*.downloads.*.uploadSpeed: The torrent's current upload speed in MB/s — the name and the unit say everything.
*.downloads.*.added: The time the download was added — a plain date.
*.downloads.*.finished: The time the download finished — a plain date, empty while it runs.
*.downloads.*.category: The program's own category or label, handed over verbatim.
